theory.title: Mustn't, don't have to y needn't
theory.explanation: Usa mustn't para indicar que algo está prohibido. Usa don't have to o needn't para decir que algo no es necesario. La diferencia es importante: You mustn't skip the medicine significa que está prohibido saltarse la medicación; you don't have to take it today significa que hoy no es necesario tomarla.
theory.tip: Mustn't = prohibición. Don't have to / needn't = no es necesario.

content.passage: The sports centre has introduced new rules. Visitors mustn't use the gym equipment without an induction, and children mustn't enter the weights area alone. Members don't have to attend every class, but they need to book in advance for swimming lessons. You needn't bring a towel because clean ones are provided. Staff remind everyone that they don't have to train every day to make progress.

items.prompt: Explain something people mustn't do at a gym.
items.modelAnswer: I think looking after your health is about building realistic habits and making balanced choices. I try to stay active, drink enough water and get regular sleep. When I feel stressed, I take a break or go for a walk. It is important to follow medical advice and ask questions when something is unclear. Small changes can make a big difference over time, especially when people keep practising them.

content.audioTranscript: A: Have you got your appointment tomorrow? B: Yes, I want to talk about my daily routine. A: Are you doing enough exercise? B: I'm trying to. The doctor gave me some useful advice. A: What did they suggest? B: Drinking more water and getting enough sleep. A: Do you need any medicine? B: No, but I need to rest during my recovery. A: I hope you feel better by tomorrow.
